import bpy, math, time
from mathutils import Vector
print('units', bpy.context.scene.unit_settings.system, bpy.context.scene.unit_settings.scale_length)
print('target', bpy.data.objects.get('Mesh_D17AB2'))
objs=[o for o in bpy.context.scene.objects if o.type=='MESH']
print('mesh_count',len(objs))
print([(o.name,len(o.data.vertices),len(o.data.polygons)) for o in objs])

import numpy as np
scene=bpy.context.scene
depsgraph=bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
geo={}
for obj in objs:
    ev=obj.evaluated_get(depsgraph)
    mesh=ev.to_mesh()
    mesh.calc_loop_triangles()
    local=np.array([tuple(v.co) for v in mesh.vertices],dtype=np.float64)
    matrix=np.array(ev.matrix_world,dtype=np.float64)
    verts=local@matrix[:3,:3].T+matrix[:3,3]
    indices=np.array([tuple(t.vertices) for t in mesh.loop_triangles],dtype=np.int64)
    geo[obj.name]={'v':verts,'f':indices,'tri':verts[indices]}
    print(obj.name,'evaluated',len(verts),len(indices),'bounds',verts.min(axis=0).tolist(),verts.max(axis=0).tolist(),'modifiers',[(m.name,m.type,m.show_viewport) for m in obj.modifiers])
    ev.to_mesh_clear()
print('mm_per_unit',scene.unit_settings.scale_length*1000)

started=time.time()
for name,data in geo.items():
    if name=='Mesh_D17AB2': continue
    minimum=float('inf')
    for first in target:
        for second in data['tri']:
            minimum=min(minimum,triangle_distance(first,second)[0])
    print(name,'exhaustive_mm',format(math.sqrt(minimum)*1000,'.12f'),'matches_pruned',abs(minimum-results[name][0])<1e-24,'pairs',len(target)*len(data['tri']))
print('seconds',time.time()-started)
print('winner_bbox_lower_bound_mm',(geo['Mesh_097A63']['v'][:,0].min()-geo['Mesh_D17AB2']['v'][:,0].max())*1000)
print('target_triangle_11',target[11].tolist())
print('winner_triangle_5',geo['Mesh_097A63']['tri'][5].tolist())
print('degenerate_triangles',{name:int(np.count_nonzero(np.linalg.norm(np.cross(data['tri'][:,1]-data['tri'][:,0],data['tri'][:,2]-data['tri'][:,0]),axis=1)==0)) for name,data in geo.items()})
